description: Release package asset scanner rules for Dennis Risk Agent semi-open packages. Path rules block mother-body assets first; bounded content rules catch sensitive strings in ordinary text files.
blocking_policy: Any critical or high finding must set package_should_block=true in scanner output.

allowlist.name: allow_field_output_policy
allowlist.reason: Runtime output policy is required.

allowlist.name: allow_redaction_policy
allowlist.reason: Runtime redaction policy is required.

allowlist.name: allow_runtime_guard
allowlist.reason: Runtime guard is required.

allowlist.name: allow_runtime_user_guide
allowlist.reason: Semi-open user guide is safe and required.

allowlist.name: allow_release_security_checklist
allowlist.reason: Release security checklist is a required packaging control.

allowlist.name: allow_asset_extraction_policy
allowlist.reason: Release asset extraction policy is required.

allowlist.name: allow_login_log_contract
allowlist.reason: Tool contract is required.

allowlist.name: allow_sso_runner
allowlist.reason: Runtime wrapper is required for readonly validation.

allowlist.name: allow_sso_runner_bin_wrapper
allowlist.reason: Reviewed runtime overlay wrapper; contains no credential material and forwards to the controlled runner.

allowlist.name: allow_platform_access_execution_run_log
allowlist.reason: Selected redacted Platform Access Execution overlay run log; no raw platform observations or auth material.

allowlist.name: allow_track_analysis_contract_correction_run_log
allowlist.reason: Selected redacted track-analysis contract correction run log; contains contract deltas only.

allowlist.name: allow_platform_access_overlay_packaging_run_log
allowlist.reason: Selected redacted Platform Access Execution overlay packaging run log.

allowlist.name: allow_platform_access_overlay_packaging_run_log_v0_1_1
allowlist.reason: Selected redacted Platform Access Execution v0.1.1 overlay packaging run log.

allowlist.name: allow_source_execution_guard_run_log
allowlist.reason: Selected redacted source execution guard patch run log; contains guard deltas only.

allowlist.name: allow_platform_access_run_logs_dir
allowlist.reason: Container directory for a single allowlisted Platform Access Execution overlay run log.

allowlist.name: allow_runtime_summaries
allowlist.reason: Distilled runtime summaries are allowed; full mother-body skills are not.

allowlist.name: allow_release_closure_summary
allowlist.reason: Selected release closure summaries may be included if redacted.

allowlist.name: allow_asset_guard_run_log
allowlist.reason: This run log records packaging guard changes without real platform data.

allowlist.name: allow_token_policy_docs
allowlist.reason: Policy docs may include token in filename without containing credential values.

allowlist.name: allow_token_contract_docs
allowlist.reason: Contract docs may include token in filename without containing credential values.

allowlist.name: allow_token_summary_docs
allowlist.reason: Summary docs may include token in filename without containing credential values.

denylist.name: git_metadata
denylist.reason: Git metadata must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove .git from the release directory.

denylist.name: nested_git_metadata
denylist.reason: Nested Git metadata must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove nested .git directories.

denylist.name: domain_skill_mother_body
denylist.reason: Full domain skill source is a restricted mother-body asset and must not enter release packages.
denylist.recommendation: Replace with files from 11_runtime_summaries only.

denylist.name: raw_skill_source
denylist.reason: Raw skill prompts are core assets.
denylist.recommendation: Replace raw skill source with a runtime-safe summary.

denylist.name: run_logs_full_directory
denylist.reason: Run logs should not be included wholesale; they can contain historical case detail and platform observations.
denylist.recommendation: Include only allowlisted release closure summaries after redaction.

denylist.name: nested_run_logs_full_directory
denylist.reason: Nested run logs indicate full process asset inclusion.
denylist.recommendation: Remove run logs or replace with a redacted closure summary.

denylist.name: runtime_question_collection_logs
denylist.reason: Runtime question collection logs may contain user prompts and feedback raw text.
denylist.recommendation: Replace with a schema, sample, or aggregate summary.

denylist.name: semi_open_pilot_raw_logs
denylist.reason: Semi-open pilot logs may contain raw user feedback or operational detail.
denylist.recommendation: Replace with an aggregate closure summary.

denylist.name: env_file
denylist.reason: Environment files often contain credentials or private endpoints.
denylist.recommendation: Remove the file; provide a redacted .env.example if needed.

denylist.name: auth_state_directory
denylist.reason: SSO auth state directory must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Delete auth state directories from release output.

denylist.name: auth_state_json
denylist.reason: Auth state JSON files must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove auth state files.

denylist.name: storage_state_json
denylist.reason: storageState JSON files must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove browser storage state files.

denylist.name: credential_named_file_cookie
denylist.reason: Cookie-bearing files must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove cookie files; do not replace them with alternate names.

denylist.name: credential_named_file_session
denylist.reason: Session-bearing files must not be packaged unless explicitly reviewed.
denylist.recommendation: Remove session files.

denylist.name: credential_named_file_token
denylist.reason: Token-named files are high risk unless explicitly allowlisted policy/contract/summary docs.
denylist.recommendation: Remove token files or rename/rewrite as a redacted policy summary.

denylist.name: credential_named_file_secret
denylist.reason: Secret-bearing files must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove secret files.

denylist.name: credential_named_file_key
denylist.reason: Credential-bearing files must not be packaged.
denylist.recommendation: Remove credential files.

denylist.name: key_named_file
denylist.reason: Key-named files may contain private keys or API keys.
denylist.recommendation: Remove the file or replace with a redacted public example.

denylist.name: historical_dist_nested
denylist.reason: Historical dist packages must not be nested in release packages.
denylist.recommendation: Remove outputs/dist from the release directory.

denylist.name: nested_release_package
denylist.reason: Nested release packages indicate packaging recursion.
denylist.recommendation: Remove nested release packages before packaging.

denylist.name: mother_body_source_in_dist
denylist.reason: outputs/dist must not contain mother-body skill/source directories.
denylist.recommendation: Rebuild dist from the sanitized release directory only.

denylist.name: drafts
denylist.reason: Drafts are development artifacts.
denylist.recommendation: Remove drafts or convert to an approved runtime summary.

denylist.name: intermediate
denylist.reason: Intermediate artifacts are development assets.
denylist.recommendation: Remove intermediate artifacts unless explicitly listed in the release manifest.

denylist.name: full_regression_case_library
denylist.reason: Full regression case libraries should not enter semi-open runtime packages.
denylist.recommendation: Replace with a minimal smoke summary and expected decisions.

denylist.name: prompt_asset
denylist.reason: Prompt source should be summarized unless runtime owner approves.
denylist.recommendation: Replace with high-level capability or usage text.

denylist.name: poc_process_file
denylist.reason: POC process files are development assets.
denylist.recommendation: Replace with release-safe runtime guidance.

denylist.name: raw_observation_directory
denylist.reason: Observation files may contain sensitive details and should be selected/redacted.
denylist.recommendation: Remove raw observations and include only derived evidence summaries.

content_denylist.name: cookie_literal
content_denylist.reason: Cookie-like credential field detected in file content.
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove the value and replace with a redacted placeholder or policy text.

content_denylist.name: token_literal
content_denylist.reason: Token-like credential field detected in file content.
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove token values; retain only redacted presence flags.

content_denylist.name: session_literal
content_denylist.reason: Session-like credential field detected in file content.
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove session values and auth state.

content_denylist.name: authorization_header
content_denylist.reason: Authorization header detected in file content.
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove complete headers and replace with a high-level auth boundary note.

content_denylist.name: api_key_literal
content_denylist.reason: API key field detected in file content.
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove API key values and rotate if this was real.

content_denylist.name: x_ks_header
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove full platform headers; keep only a redacted header category if needed.

content_denylist.name: header_literal
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove complete headers and summarize only required header classes.

content_denylist.name: mainland_phone_number
content_denylist.reason: Potential mainland China mobile phone number detected.
content_denylist.recommendation: Mask or replace with safe_ref/sample placeholder.

content_denylist.name: internal_auth_state_keyword
content_denylist.recommendation: Remove auth/session state details; keep only failure category if needed.

content_denylist.name: full_prompt_marker
content_denylist.recommendation: Replace prompt source with capability summary and safety boundary.

content_denylist.name: raw_observation_marker
content_denylist.recommendation: Replace raw response with structured, redacted evidence summary.

aggregate_rules.name: run_logs_aggregate
aggregate_rules.reason: More than one run log suggests full run log inclusion rather than a selected release closure summary.
aggregate_rules.recommendation: Keep only allowlisted redacted release closure summaries.

aggregate_rules.name: test_case_library_aggregate
aggregate_rules.reason: Multiple regression case files suggests full test library inclusion.
aggregate_rules.recommendation: Replace full case libraries with minimal regression summaries.
